description:
Search foods

About 7,800 foods with calories, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre and salt per 100 g. Search with `q` in Turkish or English (Turkish letters optional: `domates`, `tomato`, `tavuk gogsu`, `beyaz peynir`); the everyday food comes first (raw before prepared). Narrow with `category`. Use when the user asks how many calories or how much protein, fat or carbohydrate a food has, or to find a food's id for /nutrition/foods/{id} or /nutrition/calculate.

GET /v1/nutrition/foods on Nutrition & Calories (SBX-BESIN). Costs 1 credit per call.

category.description: A category id from /nutrition/categories, e.g. vegetables.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

q.description: Words to find at the start of words of the Turkish or English names, Turkish letters optional.
